body:
## Chelmsford planning approval

Chelmsford City Council has approved planning application 26/00638/CUPAMA for 41 residential units at 220 Moulsham Street Chelmsford CM2 0LR. The approved proposal is: Determination As To Whether Prior Approval Of The Local Authority Is Required For The Change Of Use Of Upper Floors Of Class E Space To Form 41 Residential Apartments, With Associated Ground Floor Bin And Cycle Storage

The application was decided on 21/07/2026. Construction Capital has reviewed the local market data for Chelmsford, Essex to provide a high-level funding view for the site.

## Local sold-price evidence

HM Land Registry sold-price data for Chelmsford shows a median residential sale price of £400,000 across 2,019 transactions in the last 12 months. The year-on-year price movement is +0.3%.

## High-level indicative development finance
